Evan K.: Quick thread for CurrencyFlow POC. They need streaming SDK + function/tool call to attach FX rates (structured JSON). VPC + SAML, 30d retention. Asks: 1) tiny Go snippet for streaming+func, 2) confirm function_call->structured event mapping, 3) hosted vs reserved pricing for ~1M tokens/mo and 500 qps peak. Timeline 3w.

Mika T.: I'll draft the Go example and include schema note. Also asking: outbound egress allowed? KMS/HSM required?

Evan K.: Customer said egress allowed with IP allowlist; prefer HSM if feasible.

Luis P.: Short answers: function_call events show up as discrete SDK events with payload string (use JSON schema in functions.parameters). Hosted sample: ~ $0.02/1k tokens -> ~$20/mo for 1M tokens. For 500 qps steady peaks recommend Dedicated reserve; rough starting commit ~$8k/mo. HSM adds infra uplift.

Luis P.: Quick Go pseudocode (super short):
```go
stream := client.Responses.Stream(ctx, StreamOptions{Model:"redwood-infer-pro-v1", Functions:[]Function{{Name:"fx_lookup", Parameters: schema}}, FunctionCall:"auto"})
for ev := range stream.Events() { if ev.Type==FunctionCall { // ev.Payload is JSON string } }
```

Mika T.: I'll attach full Go snippet + function JSON schema and sample routing policy for dedicated->hosted fallback.

SecurityBot: Uploaded security packet and SAML attribute map: https://redwood.internal/sec/currencyflow/pack_498765.pdf

BillingBot: I'll prepare two-line hosted vs 3mo-reserved quote and add expedited onboarding fee if they want 2-week turn-up.

Evan K.: Action: Mika send code + schema, Billing post quote, I'll request IDP metadata + KMS decision from customer. Thanks team :thumbsup:
